headline: Last session: Indian markets snapped two-week gains as Nifty ended at 22,600 amid surging crude oil prices.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 26 October.

why: Surging global crude oil prices nearing $114 per barrel weighed on investor sentiment.
Profit booking occurred after the market's two-week winning streak.
Volatility in global markets and Eurozone bond market fluctuations created uncertainty.
Mixed corporate earnings results for the second quarter influenced specific sectors.
whatHappening: Nifty 50 ended the last session at 22,600, recovering from intraday lows below 22,400.
Sensex closed 125 points lower after a sharp 1,250-point decline from its day's high.
IT stocks witnessed buying interest, helping the benchmarks rebound from their lowest points.
Bharat Petroleum, Coforge, and Tata Motors were among the major companies reporting Q2 results.
summary: On the last trading day, Indian indices snapped a two-week winning streak as Nifty settled at 22,600. Surging crude oil prices and profit booking triggered a volatile session, though IT stocks saw some buying interest. The market is closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Monday, October 26.
